text: Android: a 422 naming a list row cannot be quarantined, so voted_to_close on a queued list edit wedges sync

Fixed in 96aaf35. Approach (a): lists.syncBlocked (Room schema 7, MIGRATION_6_7, exported 7.json), excluded from ListDao.dirtyRows, cleared by any edit in ListsRepo, kept across a merge only while local state is unpushed — the item rules since T-32. Blocked count spans both tables; the overview attention banner falls back to a blocked list. Plus: cannot_delete_expense_list is discarded-and-re-pulled like list_closed, since a tombstoned list is invisible and could never be edited to clear a block. New SyncEngineTest, ListsRepoTest, OverviewViewModelTest and migration tests; 449 Android tests green; mutation check failed exactly the six new tests.
